gaps.sentence: We rely ___ public transport to get to work.
The committee does not approve ___ the changes.
gaps.explanation: Verb: approve OF something (noun 'approval' has no preposition).

gaps.sentence: He's brilliant ___ solving all kinds of puzzles.
gaps.explanation: Adjectives of skill take 'at': brilliant at something.

gaps.sentence: We're really looking forward ___ the trip.
gaps.explanation: look forward TO — 'to' is a preposition here, so it is followed by -ing: looking forward to seeing you.

gaps.sentence: He's completely serious ___ becoming a chef.
Doctors say stress is a major cause ___ insomnia.
She glanced ___ her watch and stood up.
I haven't heard ___ my cousin since Christmas.
gaps.explanation: hear FROM somebody = get a letter/message from them.
